name: Rutland Railroad 1945-1948
author: FUSE
description: Rutland Railroad 1945-1948 terrain package generated from the active map profile.

map.description: The Rutland Railroad's 1945-1948 Vermont operating core: Burlington to Rutland, Rutland to Bellows Falls, Rutland to North Bennington and Bennington, plus the complete period Clarendon & Pittsford marble network. Terrain follows a six-tile-wide sparse railway corridor so a uniform offset can preserve the 505-1495 m game range.
